name: DenseUnet-based Automatic Rapid Tool for brain Segmentation (DARTS)
summary: Segments a T1-weighted image into 102 brain regions, similar to FreeSurfer aparc+aseg, with the DARTS DenseUNet deep learning model and outputs a volumetric parcellation.
description: Runs the DARTS (DenseUnet-based Automatic Rapid Tool for brain Segmentation) pretrained dense-unet model on CPU to label a T1w image into 102 regions with a FreeSurfer-like key. Use it when a fast aparc+aseg-like parcellation is needed without running recon-all. The model weights are loaded from a fixed path on the original HPC system, so the App only runs where that path exists.

outputs.description: Volumetric parcellation (parc.nii.gz) in the T1w space with key.txt and label.json describing the 102 regions.

citations.text: Kaku A., Hegde C. V., Huang J., Chung S., Wang X., Young M., Radmanesh A., Lui Y. W., Razavian N. DARTS: DenseUnet-based Automatic Rapid Tool for Brain Segmentation. arXiv:1911.05567 (2019).
Avesani P. et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6, 69 (2019).
